_readme: CognitiveChain mainnet genesis. EVERY node on the network must use a
byte-identical copy of this file: its hash is part of the P2P handshake.
The allocation addresses below are REAL: their private keys were generated
with `cog-node keygen` and are held by the project owner. They are NOT
placeholders and must NOT be reused by anyone forking this repository -
generate your own with `cog-node keygen` before launching your own network.
STILL TO SET BEFORE LAUNCH: genesis_time, currently 1893456000
(2030-01-01T00:00:00Z). A node started with a future genesis_time accepts no
blocks until that moment, which is how a launch is scheduled. Set it to the
real launch time in unix seconds (`date +%s`).
Amounts are in acog; 1 COG = 100000000 acog. Max supply 1000000000 COG:
